detail: term sheet declares barrier_level_pct absent; booking has 70

triage.desk_query: Term sheet G10 contains no knock-in barrier clause — the extraction cites no span for barrier_level_pct, i.e. the document is silent on any barrier. The booking record carries barrier_level_pct = 70, implying a knock-in at 70% of initial level. Please confirm whether this note is in fact barriered and, if so, identify the term sheet section or supplement (e.g. final terms, pricing annex, or an amended/superseding document) that establishes the 70% level; if no such provision exists, confirm the booking should be amended to remove the barrier and the payoff re-booked as unbarriered.
triage.rationale: With no barrier language anywhere in the term sheet, it cannot be determined from the document alone whether the booking reflects an unpapered term, a missing supplement, or an erroneous entry, so the desk must resolve the source of the 70% figure.
